_comment: Phase 1 v0.25.0 heritage import stubs — 14 chrs added to IMPORT_PLAN
without corresponding tags or roster entries. This file STAGES the
tags + roster entries so the user can review + verify deploy chrbnd
presence before promoting them into the live nr_enemy_tags.json and
BEFORE PROMOTING: run dev/audit_chr_assets_vs_roster.py against the
user's deploy to confirm chrbnd/anibnd/behbnd/texbnd files exist for
each c-prefix below. Chrs with full asset packs are safe to promote.
Chrs missing assets should go to nr_missing_chr_files.broken_runtime_chrs
instead, or be removed from IMPORT_PLAN entirely.
All stat values (hp, hit_height, weight, variants) are sourced from
the user's mod_dump/NpcParam.csv (the actual regulation deployment).
anim_class, size_class, tier, expects_boss_arena are EDITORIAL judgments
based on ER lore + the dimensions — these are the fields most likely
to need adjustment during playtest. Marked _confidence: low.
